name: Cham villages on the Hau
nameVi: Làng Chăm Châu Phong và Đa Phước
kicker: Two Cham villages on the Hậu
summary: Cham villages on the Hậu: visit a mosque and the looms in a half day with the fish rafts. Châu Phong holds Mubarak, Jamiul Azhar, and Nia’mah. Đa Phước holds Ihsan and Sunnah. Weaving in Châu Phong is national intangible heritage, recorded with lifecycle rituals at the end of 2023. Come in daylight for the buildings and the cloth.
timeNeeded: Half a day with the rafts
getThere: By boat or road from town. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The gate of Jamiul Azhar in Châu Phong

notice.title: Match the mosque to the village
notice.body: Mubarak, Jamiul Azhar, and Nia’mah are in Châu Phong. Ihsan and Sunnah are in Đa Phước. The white gate with green trim is Jamiul Azhar. The blue-and-white mosque is in Đa Phước. Read the name on the gate you are standing at.

body: Cross the Hậu to Châu Phong and Đa Phước. The province places Châu Phong in the former town of Tân Châu, and Đa Phước in the former district of An Phú. The English guide also names Châu Giang beside Châu Phong, on two islets across the river. Mubarak is in Châu Phong, and the province lists it as a national-level architectural monument.

Walk the stilt houses and the boardwalks, and watch the weaving. The weaving in Châu Phong is national intangible cultural heritage, recorded with lifecycle rituals at the end of 2023. Veils and sarongs are part of the dress, and prayers run five times a day. Bánh bò Chăm, cooked under a hot clay lid, belongs with this visit.

The white gate with green trim is Jamiul Azhar in Châu Phong. The blue-and-white mosque stands in Đa Phước, on the right bank of the Hậu opposite town, where the province places Ihsan and Sunnah. Come in daylight for the cloth and the buildings.

figures.caption: A mosque in Đa Phước, on the right bank of the Hậu opposite Châu Đốc
figures.alt: A white and blue mosque with a minaret in Đa Phước, opposite Chau Doc

gettingThere: By boat or by road from the Châu Đốc bank. The province says the colored rafts make the link to both villages easy, and it does not print minutes. Minutes are check on arrival.
